data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella boat rental with vegan food options? You are not alone. More guests are asking for plant-based catering when chartering a yacht from Puerto Banús. Whether you are booking a budget-friendly Astondoa 40 (€749/2h) or a luxury Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h with jet ski), this guide covers what to bring, what is included, and how to ensure every meal is vegan-friendly. All our charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, soft drinks, water, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, and 21% VAT – and yes, the drinks are vegan by default.

Our fleet of 15 vessels departs exclusively from Puerto Banús, Marbella. From the 8m Dubhe (5 pax) to the 29m Ferretti 94 (12 pax), every boat can accommodate vegan provisions. Below, we answer the most common questions and share local tips for a plant-based day on the Mediterranean.

What Vegan Food Is Included on Our Charters?

Our standard light snacks are crisps, olives, and nuts – all vegan. If you have specific dietary needs, we can swap these for alternatives like hummus, vegetable sticks, or rice cakes. Just let us know at least 48 hours before departure. For longer charters (8-hour Tier A bookings at €2,299), we recommend bringing your own vegan lunch or ordering from a local caterer.

All included drinks are vegan-friendly. The white wine and cava are produced without animal-derived fining agents. If you prefer a specific brand, ask and we can confirm.

Can I Bring My Own Vegan Food?

Yes, with no restrictions. You are welcome to bring your own vegan picnic, snacks, or full meals. We recommend easy-to-eat items that travel well: wraps, salads, fruit, plant-based protein bars, and sushi. Avoid heavy sauces that might spill in waves. A reusable water bottle is smart – we provide soft drinks and water, but extra hydration is always good in 30°C heat.

If you want to order from a local vegan restaurant, we can arrange delivery to Puerto Banús before your charter. Popular options include The Green Kitchen (fully vegan) and La Vegana (vegan bowls).

Vegan Catering Services for Your Charter

We partner with local Marbella providers to offer pre-ordered vegan catering. Options include:

  • The Green Kitchen – fully vegan menu: wraps, buddha bowls, smoothies.
  • La Vegana – vegan bowls, salads, and desserts.
  • Bibo Marbella – plant-based tapas and main courses.

Delivery to the marina is included. Orders require 48-hour notice. Pricing varies based on menu choice – typical cost is €15-25 per person for a main course and sides. Browse our fleet and let us know your dietary needs when booking.

What to Pack for a Vegan-Friendly Boat Day

Beyond food, here is a packing checklist for a comfortable day on the water:

  • Sun protection: Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+), hat, sunglasses.
  • Clothing: Swimsuit, light cover-up, a windbreaker or light jacket (sea breeze can be cool).
  • Footwear: Non-slip boat shoes or barefoot – no black-soled shoes on deck.
  • Hydration: Reusable water bottle – we provide soft drinks and water, but extra is smart.
  • Electronics: Waterproof phone case, portable charger.
  • Personal items: Seasickness wristbands if prone, towel, dry bag for valuables.

Our boats are equipped with coolers, ice, and storage for your food. If you need a cooler for extra items, just ask.

All our boats can accommodate vegan provisions, but some are better suited for larger groups or longer trips:

Local Vegan Restaurants Near Puerto Banús

If you want to eat before or after your charter, these vegan-friendly spots are within walking distance of the marina:

  • The Green Kitchen – Calle Ribera, 5 min walk. Fully vegan menu.
  • La Vegana – Av. del Puerto, 10 min walk. Vegan bowls and smoothies.
  • Bibo Marbella – Golden Mile, 15 min drive. Plant-based tapas.
  • Mama's & Papas – Puerto Banús, 5 min walk. Vegan options available.

Most restaurants are happy to pack takeaway for your charter. Just call ahead.

Frequently Asked Questions

Are the drinks on board vegan-friendly?

Yes. All included drinks – water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava – are vegan-friendly. No animal products are used in production. If you have specific brand concerns, let us know and we can confirm ingredients.

Can I bring my own vegan food on the boat?

Absolutely. You are welcome to bring your own vegan picnic or snacks. There are no restrictions on outside food. We recommend packing easy-to-eat items like wraps, salads, fruit, and plant-based protein bars.

Do you offer vegan catering options?

We can arrange pre-ordered vegan catering from local Marbella providers such as The Green Kitchen or La Vegana. Delivery to Puerto Banús is included. Let us know at least 48 hours in advance.

What vegan snacks are provided as standard?

Standard light snacks include crisps, olives, and nuts – all vegan. If you have specific dietary needs, we can swap these for vegan alternatives like hummus, vegetable sticks, or rice cakes upon request.

Are there vegan restaurants near Puerto Banús?

Yes. Several nearby restaurants offer vegan options: The Green Kitchen (fully vegan), La Vegana (vegan bowls), and Bibo Marbella (plant-based dishes). Most are within a 10-minute walk from the marina.

What should I bring for a vegan-friendly day on the water?

Pack sunscreen (reef-safe), a hat, sunglasses, reusable water bottle, a light jacket for wind, and your own vegan snacks or lunch. We provide soft drinks and water, but extra hydration is always smart.

Can the skipper accommodate vegan dietary needs?

Yes. Skippers are briefed on all guest requirements. If you notify us in advance, they can adjust the onboard menu, avoid non-vegan items, and help with any special requests during the charter.

Is the jet ski included with vegan charters?

The jet ski is included free on Tier B boats (Mangusta 80, white or grey) regardless of dietary preferences. Vegan or not, you get the same inclusions: skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and jet ski.
